question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
    STRFTIME('%B', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) as month,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2016",
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2017",
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY STRFTIME('%B', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)),
         CAST(STRFTIME('%m', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY CAST(STRFTIME('%m', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
